title: Petra NDE 3114
content: I can remember it was 1976 or 1977. We lived in Helsinki. In my experience, I saw myself in a different Helsinki district setting, but everything was in silver tones, even the lawn was silver-ish. A voice said to me, 'See that young boy biking so happily there? He was run over by a truck'. The same male voice said to me 'See that lady over there', and he led me to a normal-appearing house - which didn't exist in the material world. It was located at Haaga central square. I was led in a corridor, which was flooded by an immense overflow of light - I cannot describe it better. Suddenly there was an immensely brilliant light, which came off one of the ground floor apartments. There was a friendly but extremely authoritative male voice, which said I must tell everything. Suddenly I was in hospital, hanging off from the ceiling not unlike a bat. I fell on the bed in my body. When I regained consciousness, I began to vomit.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Fatal drug overdose Clinical death (cessation of breathing or heart function or brain function) Clinical death due to heroin overdose. Lethal drug overdose.
elements.How did your highest level of consciousn: More consciousness and alertness than normal N/A.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning Time appeared to stretch and distort.
elements.Did your vision differ in any way from n: Everything appeared silver-ish and translucent, yet more intense than in the everyday world. The bright light in the corridor and apartment was not every day physical light and looking at it did not hurt, yet it was immensely brilliant.
elements.Did you seem to be aware of things going: Yes, and the facts have been checked out
elements.Did you pass into or through a tunnel?: Yes The corridor in the house, which was filled with immensely bright light.
elements.The experience included: Presence of deceased persons | Light | A landscape or city | Strong emotional tone | Special Knowledge
elements.Did you encounter or become aware of any: Yes A little boy riding a bicycle; the voice told he was run over by a truck; and a lady. The voice told who they were.
elements.Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a br: A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: Yes Immensely bright light which was not the everyday physical light.
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm Another realm which resembled a familiar hometown district, but where everything was made from silvery substance.
elements.Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity: I felt united or one with the world
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will
elements.Did you seem to encounter a mystical bei: I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin
elements.During your experience, did you gain spe: Uncertain The voice told 'you must tell everything.'
elements.Was the experience difficult to express: Uncertain Because I am submitting another person's NDE.
elements.What did you believe about the reality o: Experience was definately not real A probable hallucination caused by heroin; but heroin is not a hallucinogenic, and the experience was not similar as drug-induced hallucinations.
elements.What do you believe about the reality of: Experience was probably real. The experience resembles more the documented near-death experiences than any hallucinations, drug-induced or otherwise.
elements.At any time in your life, has anything e: Yes A couple of heroin overdoses, one of which produced a type II, negative (Void) NDE.
